subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class memory operator facade in the default memory slot now, route this to plugin/ClawHub packages, or wait until the schema/provenance/write/review companion issues are resolved?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing CLI/skill/tool semantics across memory ingestion, storage, recall, review, edit, and forgetting, while current code already has overlapping plugin-specific surfaces and open companion design issues.

options.title: Keep as Memory MVP design work
options.body: Leave this open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge, then implement a small default memory-plugin facade.

options.title: Route to plugin or ClawHub
options.body: Close core work only if maintainers decide Engram, Memory Wiki, LanceDB, or another package is the right boundary and no SDK gap remains.

options.title: Implement immediately in memory-core
options.body: Add the commands/tools now, accepting the risk of duplicating existing plugin surfaces or freezing lifecycle semantics early.

recommendation.title: Keep as Memory MVP design work
recommendation.body: Leave this open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge, then implement a small default memory-plugin facade.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has broad recent history across memory-core CLI/tool behavior, memory docs, and plugin-boundary work, making him the best visible routing candidate for the product-boundary decision.
